description: Abstract class for validation in Zend Framework, providing message handling, translation, and validation logic.

classes.name: Zend_Validate_Abstract
classes.description: An abstract class implementing common validation message handling, translation, and error management for Zend Framework validators.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Returns array of validation failure messages.

methods.name: getMessageVariables
methods.description: Returns an array of message variable names used in failure messages.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets a validation failure message template for a specific key.

methods.name: setMessages
methods.description: Sets multiple validation failure message templates.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to access 'value' or message variables.

methods.name: _createMessage
methods.description: Constructs a validation failure message, applying translation and obfuscation if needed.

methods.name: _error
methods.description: Adds an error message with a specific key and value.

methods.name: _setValue
methods.description: Sets the value to be validated and clears messages and errors.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns array of validation failure message codes (deprecated).

methods.name: setObscureValue
methods.description: Sets whether the value should be obfuscated in messages.

methods.name: getObscureValue
methods.description: Retrieves whether the value is set to be obfuscated.

methods.name: setTranslator
methods.description: Sets the translation object for message translation.

methods.name: setDefaultTranslator
methods.description: Sets the default translation object for all validators.

methods.name: getDefaultTranslator
methods.description: Retrieves the default translation object for all validators.
